memory_record.path_summary: Reanalysis tests whether the temperature-mortality relationship declined across decades by modeling log mortality rate on temperature-bin exposures with decade indicators and interactions. Task1 mirrors the original structure with full controls and multiple decade specifications. Task2 focuses on 90°F threshold and compares 1931–1959 vs 1960–2004 with reduced controls per instruction.

path_signature.main_predictor: Temperature exposure bins (b10_1–b10_10); Task2 uses b10_10 (>90°F) interacted with decade_two/decade indicators
controls: Population shares by age (sh_0000, sh_0144, sh_4564, sh_6599) and their interactions with month
lri and its interaction with month (Task1 only, excluded in Task2 per instruction)
path_signature.sample_restriction: Drop rows with missing lndrate; restrict to years >= 1931; compare pre-1960 vs post-1959 using decade_two for Task2.
path_signature.variable_construction: statemo = stfips*1000 + month; yearmo = year*1000 + month; year2 = year^2; b10_b_4 = b10_1 + b10_2 + b10_3 + b10_4; decade (11 levels by decade); decade_two (1=year<=1959, 2=year>1959).
path_signature.inference_rule: Assess sign and statistical significance of interaction terms between temperature exposures (especially b10_10) and decade indicators (decade_two or decade) to determine decline over time.

memory_record.status_reason: All checks passed; plan is aligned with the focal claim, uses authorized data, covers both tasks with clear, executable specifications, and self_check passed.
